description: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display has been launched in India, the Cupertino-based tech giant announced on Wednesday. The laptop was launched as part of the company's ‘Pro and Tell’ event. The MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display arrives as Apple’s first laptop with an OLED display, and also the first MacBook Pro model to feature a touchscreen. The MacBook Pro model is offered in two configurations, featuring Apple’s M5 Pro and M5 Max chips. It will go on sale in India on November 6 in two colour options. The MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR also supports multi-touch gestures. It packs up to a 100Wh battery.
title: MacBook Pro With PROLED XDR Display Launched in India as Apple’s First Touchscreen Laptop: Price, Specifications

description: ZeroBeta and Lynq have integrated their institutional systems on Avalanche to let eligible clients use tokenised US Treasury holdings as collateral for secured loans and digital asset trading. ZeroBeta’s BlueShift software manages collateral requirements and margin levels, while Lynq’s settlement network locks and releases pledged assets. The arrangement allows institutions to access financing and support trading positions while their Treasury holdings continue earning interest.
title: Avalanche Allows Tokenised Treasury Holdings to Secure Loans and Trades

description: Ai+ Smartphone will increase prices across select models in its Pulse 2 and Nova 2 series from November 15, 2026. The revised rates will affect multiple RAM and storage configurations, with hikes ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 3,000. The Ai+ Pulse 2 FE, Nova 2 Neo 5G and Nova 2 Ultra 5G are among the affected devices. Some existing prices include bank offers, while the Ai+ NovaFlip 5G will retain its current price of Rs. 49,999.
title: Ai+ Smartphone Prices Hiked by Up to Rs 3,000 in India From November 15: Check New Prices

description: Google opens registration for third-party Android app stores. Third-party app store developers can now enrol in the Registered App Store programme. The Registered App Store status is available in select regions. Google confirmed that starting December 1, 2026, the programme will be available on devices running Android 17 QPR2 and higher.
title: Third-Party Android App Stores Can Now Enrol in Google's Registered App Stores Programme

description: Coinbase, Bithumb, Mirae Asset Global Investments and Daishin Securities have reported data security incidents involving customer information or internal business systems. Coinbase attributed its incident to third-party analytics provider Amplitude and said customer funds remained safe. Bithumb reported unauthorised access to an internal employee communication application, while Daishin Securities disclosed a breach affecting 38,490 customers. The incidents have prompted reports to relevant authorities and investigations into the affected systems.
title: Coinbase, Bithumb and South Korean Financial Firms Report Data Leaks

description: Lava has announced festive prices for select smartphones and feature phones across online platforms and offline retail stores in India. The deals include models from the Virat, Bold and Agni series, with smartphone prices starting at Rs. 7,549 on Amazon and Rs. 9,499 on Flipkart. The Lava Agni 4 is listed at Rs. 28,249, while select feature phones will be available at lower prices on Amazon from October 30 to November 2, 2026. Eligible online purchases may also qualify for bank offers and EMI options.
title: Lava Diwali Sale Offers Announced on Smartphones and Feature Phones in India

description: The Samsung W27 is expected to arrive in China as a premium book-style foldable, with new renders offering a closer look at its design. The leaked images show a dark blue rear panel, gold-coloured frame and hinge, and three rear cameras. Earlier reports have also pointed to a possible red colour option. The handset is tipped to feature an 8-inch inner display, a 6.5-inch cover screen and a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chipset, alongside a 5,000mAh battery.
title: Samsung W27 Leaked Renders Show Foldable Phone From Multiple Angles Ahead of Launch

description: Samsung is said to be working on two new devices for the Galaxy Z Fold 9 series. The two proposed devices would serve different purposes within the company's foldable lineup. The Galaxy Z Fold 9 Plus could focus on a larger form factor and battery. The Galaxy Z Fold 9 FE could arrive as an affordable model.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9 Plus or Galaxy Z Fold 9 FE Could Launch in 2027

description: iQOO Neo 12 has been launched in China, the smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. The handset was unveiled along with the new iQOO Pad Pro 8.8. The iQOO Neo 12 is set to go on sale in the country soon via the Vivo online store. The handset is offered in three colour options, namely Contest, Shadow Black, and Frost Blade Blue (translated from Chinese). The phone is powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, which is Qualcomm’s flagship mobile platform from last year. The iQOO Neo 12 is equipped with a dual rear camera system. It packs a 9,000mAh battery. The phone sports a 2K resolution screen that refreshes at up to 185Hz.
title: iQOO Neo 12 Launched With 9,000mAh Battery, 185Hz Super AMOLED Display: Price, Specifications

description: iQOO Pad Pro 8.8 was launched in China on Wednesday. The compact tablet promises to offer flagship performance in a smaller form factor. It sports an 8.8-inch AMOLED screen with a 165Hz refresh rate. The tablet is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, paired with up to 16GB of RAM. The iQOO Pad Pro 8.8 packs a 9,020mAh battery with 66W charging support.
title: iQOO Pad Pro 8.8 Launched With 165Hz AMOLED Display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Ahead of its official launch in China, OnePlus has teased that its Ace 7 Series will feature a tri-cluster chip setup to enhance the phone’s gaming capabilities. The phones are expected to feature 9,000mAh batteries and Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 platform.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Teased to Get Tri-Cluster ‘E-Sport’ Chip Setup Ahead of October 29 Launch

description: Sony's LYTIA 720 image sensor has launched for mobile devices. It is a stacked CMOS image sensor with approximately 50 effective megapixels and a pixel size of 1.0 micrometre. It is scheduled to begin shipping in early November 2026. It supports 4K resolution at 60 frames per second with HDR enabled and all-pixel autofocus. It is claimed to offer a dynamic range of 100dB through HDR compositing technology.
title: Sony LYTIA 720 Image Sensor Launched With 50-Megapixel Resolution, 4K 60fps HDR Video Support

description: LG's new 115-inch QNED Evo AI Mini LED TV features a 4K display with Mini LED backlighting, Dolby Vision support and a native 120Hz refresh rate. It supports variable refresh rates of up to 165Hz and Motion Booster up to 330Hz for gaming. The television also offers Dolby Atmos audio, virtual 11.1.2-channel surround sound and AI-based picture processing. Running webOS 26, it includes Google Gemini and Microsoft Copilot integration, along with Google Cast, Apple AirPlay and smart home connectivity options.
title: LG 115-Inch QNED Evo AI Mini LED TV Launched in India With 4K Display, 165Hz VRR: Price, Features

description: OnePlus Ace 7 will run on Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V Series chipset. The OnePlus Ace 7 Pro is confirmed to feature the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 processor. The standard model is teased to feature a 9,000mAh battery with support for 100W SuperVOOC fast charging. It will also include a 200-megapixel primary rear camera.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Confirmed to Feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V Series Chip, 9,000mAh Battery

description: OpenAI, on Tuesday, announced that it has introduced the iCloud Mail and iCloud Calendar plugins for ChatGPT. OpenAI said that the new plugins for Apple users can be accessed via the ChatGPT web version. Alternatively, users can use the ChatGPT desktop or ChatGPT iOS apps to access them. Moreover, the iCloud Mail and iCloud Calendar plugins are available for all ChatGPT plans, including Free, Go, Plus, and Pro. This adds to the list of mailing services plugins that ChatGPT users can add. OpenAI already offers plugins for Gmail, Outlook Email, Mailopoly, Superhuman Mail, and Hostinger Mail. By adding these plugins to their ChatGPT account, users allow OpenAI’s AI-powered chatbot to access their emails and calendar schedule. With a text prompt, users can ask ChatGPT to look for a particular email and retrieve specific information from it.
title: ChatGPT Can Now Access iCloud Mail and Calendar as OpenAI Introduces New Plugins

description: Vivo has launched the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in select global markets. The smartphones feature AMOLED displays with refresh rates of up to 144Hz, MediaTek Dimensity chipsets and ZEISS-branded cameras. The X500 Pro Max includes a 200-megapixel telephoto camera, while battery capacities reach 7,800mAh. All three models support 90W wired and 40W wireless charging. The series is expected to launch in India by the end of November.
title: Vivo X500, X500 Pro, X500 Pro Max Launched Globally: Price, Specifications

description: Delhi residents can now book liquor online through a dedicated mobile app. The government has launched the Delhi Liquor Booking app ahead of Diwali that makes it easier for users browse available brands, select bottle sizes and pay for their purchases digitally. It has been developed by the Delhi State Industrial and Infrastructure Development Corporation (DSIIDC) and currently works only with liquor stores operated by the corporation. The new service, however, does not include a home delivery option.
title: Delhi Liquor Booking App Goes Live: No Home Delivery, Here's How It Works

description: Redmi Book 14 2027 and Redmi Book 16 2027 have been launched in China as part of the new Redmi Book 2027 series. Both laptops are scheduled to go on sale in China on November 3 via the Xiaomi online store. The Redmi Book 14 2027 is offered in Moonlight Silver, Nebula Purple, Sea Breeze Blue, and Space Gray (translated from Chinese) colour options. However, the Redmi Book 16 2027 will be available in only Moonlight Silver and Space Gray (translated from Chinese) colourways. Both the Redmi Book 16 2027 and Redmi Book 14 2027 are powered by up to an Intel Core 7 350 processor, along with 16GB of LPDDR5x RAM, up to a 1TB SSD for onboard storage, and an integrated Intel Graphics chip.
title: Redmi Book 14 2027 and Book 16 2027 Launched With Up to Intel Core 7 Processor, 72Wh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 could reportedly take up 210GB of SSD storage on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. That's according to information shared by PlayStation Game Size and corroborated by Insider Gaming. Rockstar has not yet confirmed the full download size and console performance of GTA 6. The game launches on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X on November 19.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Reportedly Take Up 210GB of SSD Storage on Consoles

description: The Infinix Note 70 Pro is the unannounced successor to the Note 60 Pro, which was launched as a mid-range smartphone in India a few months ago. The device’s highlight was its Active Matrix Display embedded into its rear camera module, which lit up to display notifications. The Infinix Note 70 Pro has now appeared on Geekbench, revealing its performance hardware details.
title: Infinix Note 70 Pro Spotted on Geekbench Revealing Key Specifications: Here's What You Need to Know

description: Xiaomi 18 is tipped to arrive with a compact display. The upcoming smartphone is tipped to feature Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset. It is rumoured to feature a 7,000mAh battery. The Xiaomi 18 is tipped to come with a dual 200-megapixel rear camera setup. It is also said to retain a relatively compact form factor.
title: Xiaomi 18 Specifications Leaked; Said to Feature Dual 200-Megapixel Cameras

description: Motorola Signature 27 will be launched in India in November, as a dedicated microsite for the handset is now live on the Motorola India website. The microsite reveals that the Motorola Signature 27 will be powered by Qualcomm’s octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, which delivers a peak clock speed of up to 5.01GHz. The handset will also feature a quad rear camera unit, housed inside a redesigned rectangular camera module. It will also ship with the Bang & Olufsen audio system. The phone will be offered in at least black and green colour options.
title: Motorola Signature 27 Confirmed to Launch in India Next Month as Microsite Goes Live on Company’s Website

description: Google DeepMind on Tuesday announced Genie 4 as its latest world model. The Mountain View-based tech giant says it can create realistic, interactive simulations that respond to user inputs in real time. The world model is claimed to be capable of generating environments with natural movement, realistic physics, and native audio, including ambient sounds, music, and interactive character dialogue. As per Google, Genie 4 is currently being tested with trusted partners.
title: Google DeepMind Introduces Genie 4 With Real-Time Simulation, Native Audio Generation

description: Samsung is rolling out the stable One UI 9 update, based on Android 17, to the Galaxy M56, Galaxy M17, Galaxy F17, and Galaxy A35 in India. The update includes the October 2026 security patch and software improvements. The software brings interface updates, system improvements, and updated security protections to the mid-range phones. Users can check for the update through the Software update section in Settings.
title: Samsung Rolls Out Stable One UI 9 Update for Galaxy M56, Galaxy M17, Galaxy F17, Galaxy A35 in India: Report

description: The Redmi Clip Neo are priced at CNY 399 (roughly Rs. 38,000) in China, with a limited-edition Redmi × CryingCenter gift box available for CNY 449 (roughly Rs. 42,700). The earbuds feature 12mm dual-magnetic drivers, four preset equaliser modes and a custom 10-band equaliser. They support Bluetooth 5.4, dual-device connectivity and AI-assisted call noise reduction. Additional features include customisable button controls, Xiaomi's Super Xiao AI and HyperOS integration. Each earbud weighs 5.3g and offers up to seven hours of playback, with a total of 32 hours using the charging case.
title: Redmi Clip Neo Open-Ear Earbuds Launched With 12mm Drivers, Up to 32 Hours of Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Redmi K100 has been launched in China as the standard model in the company’s K100 series. The smartphone will go on sale in the country on October 31 via the Xiaomi online store. The handset is offered in three colour options, namely Black, Fluorescent Green, and Snow Rock White (translated from Chinese). It is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset. The Redmi K100 boasts a 10,000mAh battery and offers support for 100W wired fast charging. It carries a dual rear camera unit, with a 50-megapixel primary shooter.
title: Redmi K100 Launched With 10,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin remains above $80,000 as traders await the US Federal Reserve’s policy decision and assess the possibility of a rate hike in December. US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded fresh inflows after two sessions of substantial withdrawals, although institutional confidence remains fragile. Market participants are also monitoring key Bitcoin support and resistance levels as global equities and economic data influence sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $80,000 as ETF Inflows Return

description: Having already launched the iPad mini (2026), M6-powered MacBook Pro, and the iMac (2026) in recent days, Apple’s focus is now shifting to the touchscreen MacBook with an OLED screen. The Cupertino-based tech giant is expected to unveil the laptop at its ‘Pro and Tell’ showcase later today. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a seasoned journalist has speculated on its pricing. It could be significantly more expensive than the previous generation MacBooks.
title: Apple’s OLED Touchscreen MacBook Pro Could Reportedly Cost More Than Current Models

description: Apple announced a major update to the Apple Creator Studio on Tuesday. The Cupertino-based tech giant has introduced new AI-powered tools and creative features across its video editing, music production, image editing, and productivity apps. The Final Cut Pro app now includes MotionVFX effects and improved editing workflows, while Logic Pro introduces an intelligent assistant and an upgraded Stem Splitter. Apple is also adding new AI assistants and workflow automation support to Keynote, Pages, and Numbers.
title: Apple Creator Studio Gets New AI Assistants, MotionVFX Tools and Generate Fill

description: The Moto G47 Power was launched in select global markets on Tuesday. The handset builds upon the Moto G47 and packs a larger battery. It sports a 6.67-inch LCD screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. The handset is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, paired with 4GB of RAM. The Moto G47 Power runs Android 16 out of the box and comes with a 108-megapixel rear camera. It packs a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Moto G47 Power Launched With 108-Megapixel Camera, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications
